business_rules.text: BR01: The Smart City application shall provide six modules: Administration, Tourism, Student, Sport Events, Job Applicant, and Business.
BR02: The Administration module shall manage city information and user profiles.
BR03: The Tourism module shall provide information about hotels, restaurants, tourist attractions, ATMs, theatres, and related services.
BR04: Users shall be able to search and view tourism information.
BR05: The Student module shall provide information about universities, colleges, libraries, coaching centres, and educational establishments.
BR06: Educational establishments shall be associated with a city.
BR07: The Sport Events module shall display sporting events, dates, venues, and locations.
BR08: Users shall be able to reserve or purchase tickets for sporting events.
BR09: Every sporting event shall be associated with a venue.
BR10: The Job Applicant module shall display job opportunities in different industries.
BR11: Each job listing shall be associated with a company or employer.
BR12: The Business module shall provide information about businesses, industries, business centres, and relevant news.
BR13: Users shall be able to search and view city information across the six modules.
BR14: Location information shall be displayed on a map when coordinates are available.
BR15: Registered users shall have unique email addresses.
BR16: A registered user may have multiple roles, including USER, STUDENT, ADMIN, and TOURIST.
BR17: Students shall be able to manage their own CV records.
BR18: Registered users shall be able to submit job applications.
BR19: Job applications shall not be submitted after the job deadline.
BR20: A user shall not have duplicate active applications for the same job.
BR21: Registered users shall be able to view their own bookings and job applications.
BR22: A venue reservation shall have a start time earlier than its end time.
BR23: Confirmed venue reservations shall not overlap for the same venue.
BR24: Users shall be able to save and view favourite city listings.
BR25: Only authorised administrators shall modify protected city records.
BR26: Users shall only modify their own personal information, CVs, bookings, and applications unless explicitly authorised.
BR27: Detailed authentication and authorisation rules shall be finalised during the security implementation phase.
